definitions.gloss: empty can; used beverage or food can
definitions.explanation: A can that has been emptied of its contents. Commonly encountered in the context of recycling and litter.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
examples.english: To pick up an empty can.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{缶|かん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{潰|つぶ}して→潰す：00410_tsubusu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Crush empty cans before putting them out for recycling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{空|あ}き{缶|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{落|お}ちていて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧だった。
examples.english: It was unfortunate that there were so many empty cans littering the road.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{空|あ}き→空く：11062_aku⟧ (empty) + ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧ (can). Very commonly encountered in signs about recycling and waste separation in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{潰|つぶ}す→潰す：00410_tsubusu⟧: to crush an empty can
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away an empty can
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: empty can collection
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}ポイ{捨|す}て: littering with empty cans

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{空|あ}き{瓶|びん}→空き瓶：18915_akibin⟧: empty bottle
- {空|あ}き{箱|はこ}: empty box
- ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧: can — the base word; ⟦{缶詰|かんづめ}→缶詰：00187_kanzume⟧ (canned food), ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧ (canned juice)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has strict waste separation rules. {空|あ}き{缶|かん} is one of the standard recycling categories, alongside ⟦{空|あ}き{瓶|びん}→空き瓶：18915_akibin⟧ (bottles) and ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧ (PET bottles).
